phase6.name: AI Issue Generator - Self-Explanatory Intelligent Auto-Fix
phase6.description: AI-powered issue resolution system that provides self-explanatory issue descriptions, uses code-analyzer for symbol queries and LINQ-like code analysis, applies line-level fixes, researches solutions online, and validates results with intelligent error recovery
keyFeatures: Line-level code editing (not full file rewrites)
Code-analyzer integration for symbol queries and context
LINQ-style code analysis and pattern matching
Local-first AI execution with cloud fallback
Intelligent error recovery with enhanced context
